script: Mars has two tiny moons, Phobos and Deimos. Phobos orbits so close that it circles Mars three times a day. It is slowly spiraling inward, getting closer every year. In tens of millions of years it will either crash or break apart. Its pieces might even form a ring around Mars. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
